adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, email comparisons are done without any case normalization: `isAttendee` uses `attendee.email === user.email`, and `uniqueGuests` filtering uses `guest === attendee.email` and `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`. However, `blacklistedGuestEmails` is explicitly lowercased while `guest` is not, so mixed-case input can bypass the blacklist. Likewise, `guest` casing differences can bypass the duplicate-attendee check, allowing a second attendee row for the same mailbox in different case. The input schema (`z.string().email()`) validates format but does not normalize casing. This is a real behavioral defect grounded in the diff.
